sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店打碟的黑胶唱片时代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带着你最珍视的 300 件宝贝去工作，把 DJ 台变成一个充满 50 年历史精美文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, one day out from the special election in Alabama, the question is, will voters there find it harder to support Roy Moore or a Democrat?
sentences.zh: 今天，距离阿拉巴马州特别选举还有一天，问题是，那里的选民会觉得支持罗伊·摩尔更难，还是支持民主党人更难？

sentences.en: And the newly emboldened conservative provocateur, James O'Keefe.
sentences.zh: 还有那位新近胆气壮大的保守派煽动者，詹姆斯·奥基夫。

sentences.en: It's Monday, December 11th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 12 月 11 日，星期一。

sentences.en: Thank you for calling the Elos and Elos.
sentences.zh: 感谢致电 Elos and Elos 律师事务所。

sentences.en: My name is Liz.
sentences.zh: 我叫莉兹。

sentences.en: How may I assist you?
sentences.zh: 请问有什么可以帮您？

sentences.en: Hey, I'm trying to reach a guest named Jonathan Martin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我想找一位叫乔纳森·马丁的嘉宾。

sentences.en: And may I ask your name?
sentences.zh: 请问您贵姓？

sentences.en: Michael.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔。

sentences.en: Give me one second, please.
sentences.zh: 请稍等一下。

sentences.en: Jonathan Martin is covering the election from Birmingham.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森·马丁正在伯明翰报道这次选举。

sentences.en: There's snow on the ground down here, actually.
sentences.zh: 其实我们这边地上有雪。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: There is here too.
sentences.zh: 我们这儿也有。

sentences.en: Well, a little bit.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有一点点。

sentences.en: It's kind of mush.
sentences.zh: 有点像烂泥。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So I'm going to jump in.
sentences.zh: 那我就直接切入正题了。

sentences.en: Ready?
sentences.zh: 准备好了吗？

sentences.en: Jonathan, it's the final weekend going into what I think we can say safely is the most unique special election that you or I have ever seen.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，现在是最后一个周末，即将迎来我认为可以稳妥地说，是你我见过的最独特的特别选举。

sentences.en: This race in Alabama, what happens over the weekend?
sentences.zh: 阿拉巴马州的这场竞选，周末发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, the most striking development, Michael, over the weekend was Senator Richard Shelby, who is perhaps the most prominent Republican in the state.
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克尔，周末最引人注目的进展是理查德·谢尔比参议员，他或许是该州最著名的共和党人。

sentences.en: He's been in elected office for over 45 years.
sentences.zh: 他担任民选公职已经超过 45 年了。

sentences.en: Went on a Sunday talk show, which he does not do very often.
sentences.zh: 他参加了一个周日访谈节目，这对他来说并不常见。

sentences.en: He's now 83 years old.
sentences.zh: 他现在已经 83 岁了。

sentences.en: He's not a fixture on the television networks.
sentences.zh: 他不是电视网的常客。

sentences.en: But he went on a Sunday show on CNN, and being a canny political veteran, he knew exactly the question that was going to be asked.
sentences.zh: 但他参加了 CNN 的一档周日节目，作为一名精明的政治老手，他非常清楚会被问到什么问题。

sentences.en: Let's get right to Alabama's senior Republican Senator Richard Shelby, who joins us now from Tuscaloosa.
sentences.zh: 让我们直接连线阿拉巴马州资深共和党参议员理查德·谢尔比，他现在正在塔斯卡卢萨。

sentences.en: Senator, thank you so much for joining us.
sentences.zh: 参议员，非常感谢您参加我们的节目。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们不胜感激。

sentences.en: Got the question about Roy Moore.
sentences.zh: 问到了关于罗伊·摩尔的问题。

sentences.en: When it comes down to it on Tuesday, who would you rather see win?
sentences.zh: 到了周二投票的时候，你更希望谁赢？

sentences.en: And he took a hatchet out and went out for Roy Moore hard.
sentences.zh: 他拿出了斧头，狠狠地砍向罗伊·摩尔。

sentences.en: I couldn't vote for Roy Moore.
sentences.zh: 我无法投票给罗伊·摩尔。

sentences.en: I didn't vote for Roy Moore, but I wrote in a distinguished Republican name.
sentences.zh: 我没有投票给罗伊·摩尔，但我写下了一位杰出的共和党人的名字。

sentences.en: He already filled out an absentee ballot with somebody else who he wouldn't reveal.
sentences.zh: 他已经填写了一张缺席选票，投给了他未透露姓名的某个人。

sentences.en: We knew he wouldn't support Moore.
sentences.zh: 我们知道他不会支持摩尔。

sentences.en: But the fact that Shelby decided to say yes to a Sunday show two days before the election, apparently for the purpose of just going hard at Mr. Moore.
sentences.zh: 但谢尔比决定在选举前两天接受周日节目的采访，显然就是为了猛烈抨击摩尔先生。

sentences.en: I want to reiterate again, I didn't vote for Roy Moore.
sentences.zh: 我想再次重申，我没有投票给罗伊·摩尔。

sentences.en: I wouldn't vote for Roy Moore.
sentences.zh: 我不会投票给罗伊·摩尔。

sentences.en: I think the Republican Party can do better.
sentences.zh: 我认为共和党可以做得更好。

sentences.en: It really captures just how bizarre this race is,
sentences.zh: 这确实体现了这场竞选有多么离奇，

sentences.en: where kind of the leading Republican in the state chooses to try to torpedo the campaign of the Republican nominee for what would be the other seat in Alabama.
sentences.zh: 州里主要的共和党人竟然选择试图摧毁本党候选人在阿拉巴马州另一个席位的竞选活动。

sentences.en: I tell you what, there's a time, we call it a tipping point.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你，有一个时刻，我们称之为临界点。

sentences.en: And I think so many accusations, so many cuts, so many drip, drip, drip.
sentences.zh: 我认为太多的指控，太多的打击，太多的点滴积累。

sentences.en: When it got to the 14-year-old story, that was enough for me.
sentences.zh: 当涉及到那个 14 岁女孩的故事时，对我来说这就够了。

sentences.en: I said, I can't vote for Roy Moore.
sentences.zh: 我说，我不能投票给罗伊·摩尔。

sentences.en: He thinks the women who have charged Mr. Moore with sexual misconduct are believable.
sentences.zh: 他认为那些指控摩尔先生性骚扰的女性是可信的。

sentences.en: I have no reason not to believe him, just like the Attorney General Sessions said.
sentences.zh: 我没有理由不相信他，就像司法部长塞申斯所说的那样。

sentences.en: He had no reason or something not to believe the women.
sentences.zh: 他没有理由还是什么的，不相信这些女性。

sentences.en: They were credible.
sentences.zh: 她们是可信的。

sentences.en: But, you know, I wasn't there.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我当时不在场。

sentences.en: I don't know what happened.
sentences.zh: 我不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: But there's a lot of stories there.
sentences.zh: 但那里有很多故事。

sentences.en: There's a lot of smoke.
sentences.zh: 有很多传闻。

sentences.en: Got to be some fire somewhere.
sentences.zh: 无风不起浪。

sentences.en: And I think what he was trying to do, Michael, is effectively stop Moore's campaign here in the final hours.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我认为他试图做的是在最后时刻有效地阻止摩尔的竞选。

sentences.en: I was really struck by the fact that Shelby seemed to be encouraging Republicans in Alabama not to vote for the Democrat, which seemed like a bridge too far for him,
sentences.zh: 让我印象深刻的是，谢尔比似乎在鼓励阿拉巴马州的共和党人不要投票给民主党人，这对他来说似乎太过分了，

sentences.en: but to write in on their ballots just any other Republican.
sentences.zh: 而是让他们在选票上写下任何其他共和党人的名字。

sentences.en: And that's effectively a vote for Doug Jones, the Democrat, Michael, because all that does, it just lowers the threshold of votes that the Democrat needs to win here.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，这实际上等同于投给民主党人道格·琼斯，因为这只会降低民主党人获胜所需的票数门槛。

sentences.en: So basically, if two or three percent of Alabamians write somebody in, then Jones wouldn't have to hit 50.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，如果百分之二或三的阿拉巴马人写下别人的名字，那么琼斯就不必达到 50%。

sentences.en: He could just get 48 or 49 and still win.
sentences.zh: 他只要拿到 48% 或 49% 就能赢。

sentences.en: And the fact that in a close race that Shelby would choose to do this could prove consequential.
sentences.zh: 在竞争激烈的选战中，谢尔比选择这样做可能会产生严重后果。

sentences.en: Coming up next on The Voice of Alabama Politics, a special edition with Judge Roy Moore.
sentences.zh: 接下来是《阿拉巴马政治之声》特别节目，嘉宾是罗伊·摩尔法官。

sentences.en: So also on Sunday, we had Roy Moore himself speaking out for the first time in a while.
sentences.zh: 所以周日那天，罗伊·摩尔本人也久违地公开发声了。

sentences.en: What did he say?
sentences.zh: 他说了什么？

sentences.en: Well, he did his own television appearance.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他自己上了一档电视节目。

sentences.en: It wasn't quite CNN.
sentences.zh: 那可不是 CNN。

sentences.en: Welcome to The Voice of Alabama Politics, where we tackle the tough issues so you have the hard facts.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到《阿拉巴马政治之声》，我们在这里探讨棘手议题，为您提供确凿事实。

sentences.en: I'm your host, Bill Britt.
sentences.zh: 我是主持人比尔·布里特。

sentences.en: And today we are at Republican headquarters outside of Birmingham.
sentences.zh: 今天我们在伯明翰郊外的共和党总部。

sentences.en: To put it mildly, very friendly interlocutor.
sentences.zh: 委婉地说，这是一位非常友好的对话者。

sentences.en: You and I live in the same, basically the same community.
sentences.zh: 你和我基本上生活在同一个社区。

sentences.en: We know a lot of the same folks, not political folks, just home folks.
sentences.zh: 我们认识很多相同的人，不是政客，只是街坊邻居。

sentences.en: So I've spent a lot of time over the last couple of weeks talking to people in Etowah County that have known you for years and years.
sentences.zh: 过去几周我花了很多时间与埃托瓦县认识你多年的人交谈。

sentences.en: And they're still supporting you.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然支持你。

sentences.en: The questioning was gentle, but Mr. Moore did really face these questions for the first time.
sentences.zh: 提问很温和，但摩尔先生确实是第一次直面这些问题。

sentences.en: And he reiterated that he did not know these women.
sentences.zh: 他重申他不认识这些女性。

sentences.en: I did not know them.
sentences.zh: 我不认识她们。

sentences.en: I had no encounter with them.
sentences.zh: 我和她们没有任何接触。

sentences.en: I never molested anyone.
sentences.zh: 我从未猥亵过任何人。

sentences.en: And for them to say that, I don't know why they're saying it, but it's not true.
sentences.zh: 她们那样说，我不知道她们为什么要这么说，但这不是真的。

sentences.en: That's a slight difference from what he said in the first days after these charges were made, where he denied impropriety,
sentences.zh: 这与指控刚出来那几天他说的话略有不同，当时他否认有不当行为，

sentences.en: but he didn't totally rule out the fact that he had dated teenagers, saying famously, at the time, he never dated anybody without their mother's permission.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有完全排除他曾与青少年约会的事实，并留下了那句名言：他从未在没有母亲许可的情况下与任何人约会。

sentences.en: Judge Moore, we appreciate you.
sentences.zh: 摩尔法官，感谢您的到来。

sentences.en: Thank you for being on today.
sentences.zh: 感谢您今天参加节目。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Bill.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，比尔。

sentences.en: You've been watching The V, the voice of Alabama politics.
sentences.zh: 您刚才收看的是《V》，即阿拉巴马政治之声。

sentences.en: Our special guest today has been Judge Roy Moore.
sentences.zh: 我们今天的特别嘉宾是罗伊·摩尔法官。

sentences.en: He is running for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他正在竞选美国

sentences.en: Senate.
sentences.zh: 参议院席位。

sentences.en: Thank you for watching The V.
sentences.zh: 感谢收看《V》。

sentences.en: You watch us because we watch them.
sentences.zh: 你们看我们的节目，因为我们在监督他们。

sentences.en: Jonathan, you're in Alabama.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，你在阿拉巴马州。

sentences.en: What's actually happening here?
sentences.zh: 那里到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: Help us understand what this is really about there now at this point in the race.
sentences.zh: 帮我们了解一下，在竞选的这个阶段，这到底是怎么回事。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: So you've got a Democratic campaigner, Doug Jones, who's bringing in a number of out-of-state surrogates to help him campaign, figures like Cory Booker, senator from New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 你有一位民主党竞选人道格·琼斯，他请来了许多外州代理人来帮他竞选，比如来自新泽西州的参议员科里·布克。

sentences.en: You've got a lot of national liberal money that's flooded into the state, Michael, that's being used for get-off-the-vote effort.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，大量的全国性自由派资金涌入该州，被用于动员投票工作。

sentences.en: And in black churches on Sunday, the pastors were talking about the importance of voting from the pulpit.
sentences.zh: 周日，在黑人教堂里，牧师们在讲坛上谈论投票的重要性。

sentences.en: And I was in a black church in Selma, and in the lobby of the church, there were sample ballots for Doug Jones,
sentences.zh: 我当时在塞尔玛的一座黑人教堂，在教堂大厅里，有道格·琼斯的选票样本，

sentences.en: and on every car under the windshield was a Doug Jones piece of literature.
sentences.zh: 每一辆车的挡风玻璃下都放着道格·琼斯的宣传单。

sentences.en: So the black vote is critical to Democrats in Alabama.
sentences.zh: 所以黑人选票对阿拉巴马州的民主党人至关重要。

sentences.en: In fact, if you talk to people here working on the campaign,
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果你和这里竞选团队的人交谈，

sentences.en: they can even pinpoint what percent of the statewide electorate has to be African-American for Doug Jones to have a chance to win.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至能精确指出全州选民中非裔美国人必须达到多少比例，道格·琼斯才有机会获胜。

sentences.en: And so they will say that if the African-American percentage of the statewide electorate is above 25 percent, then Jones has a real—
sentences.zh: 所以他们会说，如果全州选民中非裔美国人的比例超过 25%，那么琼斯就有真正的——

sentences.en: And what about on the Republican side?
sentences.zh: 那共和党方面呢？

sentences.en: What's going on with Moore in these final days?
sentences.zh: 摩尔在最后几天情况如何？

sentences.en: On the Republican side, it's much different because basically Moore is trying to avoid questions and scrutiny about his conduct with these women.
sentences.zh: 共和党方面则大不相同，因为摩尔基本上是在试图回避关于他与这些女性行为的质询和审查。

sentences.en: So he's not holding public events.
sentences.zh: 所以他没有举行公开活动。

sentences.en: He's being very quiet.
sentences.zh: 他非常低调。

sentences.en: He didn't show up in his own home church today.
sentences.zh: 他今天甚至没有出现在他自己的家乡教堂。

sentences.en: He's basically gone underground, Michael, for the last week of this campaign.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，在竞选的最后一周，他基本上销声匿迹了。

sentences.en: He's largely been invisible in Alabama.
sentences.zh: 他在阿拉巴马州几乎隐身了。

sentences.en: He's got one rally before Tuesday scheduled, and it's in a very rural part of southeast Alabama.
sentences.zh: 他在周二之前只安排了一场集会，而且是在阿拉巴马州东南部一个非常偏远的地区。

sentences.en: So it's basically Moore trying to run out the clock and Jones, with the help of millions of dollars in national money, scrambling to get every vote out possible.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上是摩尔试图拖延时间，而琼斯在数百万美元全国资金的帮助下，正拼命争取每一张选票。

sentences.en: Finally, Jonathan, is the sense on the ground that Roy Moore is going to win this election, or is that a true question mark still?
sentences.zh: 最后，乔纳森，当地的感觉是罗伊·摩尔会赢得这次选举，还是这仍然是一个真正的未知数？

sentences.en: It's a question mark.
sentences.zh: 这是一个未知数。

sentences.en: I think it's hard to predict special elections under any circumstances.
sentences.zh: 我认为在任何情况下都很难预测特别选举。

sentences.en: When you've got one candidate who's gone underground for days because he doesn't want to answer questions about sexual misconduct with teenage girls,
sentences.zh: 当你有一位候选人因为不想回答关于与未成年少女发生性行为的指控而躲藏了几天时，

sentences.en: it's really uncertain about what's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 周二会发生什么真的很难说。

sentences.en: So I think we're flying blind into this election on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们对周二的这场选举完全是盲人摸象。

sentences.en: This is a deep red state.
sentences.zh: 这是一个深红州。

sentences.en: This is the deep south.
sentences.zh: 这是美国深南部。

sentences.en: They rarely support Democrats statewide, but it's really a test in this state, which is harder for folks to do,
sentences.zh: 他们很少在全州范围内支持民主党人，但这确实是对该州的一次考验，哪种选择对人们来说更难，

sentences.en: to support somebody who's been accused of sexual misconduct with teenagers or to pull the lever for a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 是支持一个被指控与未成年人有不当性行为的人，还是投票给民主党人。

sentences.en: Thank you, Jonathan.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，乔纳森。

sentences.en: All right, guys.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位。

sentences.en: Thanks, y'all.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Cheers.
sentences.zh: 干杯。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11 月 18 日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化界最具影响力的人物，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无保留、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在 11 月 18 日在 NYTimes.com 上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download The New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得一个月的免费访问权限，阅读我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Did you see all the corrections the media's been making?
sentences.zh: 你看到媒体所做的所有更正了吗？

sentences.en: They're saying, sorry, we made a—they've been doing that all year.
sentences.zh: 他们说，抱歉，我们犯了个——他们整年都在这么干。

sentences.en: They never apologized.
sentences.zh: 他们从来没道过歉。

sentences.en: Maybe that comes with being the president.
sentences.zh: 也许这就是当总统的代价吧。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: After several recent mistakes by news organizations and individual reporters— They took this fraudster from ABC.
sentences.zh: 在新闻机构和个别记者最近犯下几次错误之后——他们从美国广播公司（ABC）挖来了这个骗子。

sentences.en: They suspended him for a month.
sentences.zh: 他们让他停职了一个月。

sentences.en: They should have fired him for what he wrote.
sentences.zh: 就凭他写的东西，他们本该直接开除他。

sentences.en: President Trump has escalated his criticism that the media is unfairly targeting him.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统升级了他的批评，称媒体在不公正地针对他。

sentences.en: And then CNN apologized just a little while ago.
sentences.zh: 就在不久前，美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）道歉了。

sentences.en: They apologized.
sentences.zh: 他们道歉了。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you, CNN.
sentences.zh: 哦，谢谢你，CNN。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 太感谢了。

sentences.en: You should have been apologizing for the last two years.
sentences.zh: 你们过去两年就该道歉了。

sentences.en: He's been helped in this fight by a longtime conservative provocateur who'd been operating on the margins for a decade.
sentences.zh: 在这场斗争中，他得到了一位长期保守派煽动者的帮助，此人十年来一直游走在边缘地带。

sentences.en: It's that you won't touch.
sentences.zh: 那是你不会触碰的。

sentences.en: That's why we exiSt.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们存在的原因。

sentences.en: Ken Vogel, you recently spoke to James O'Keefe.
sentences.zh: 肯·沃格尔，你最近采访了詹姆斯·奥基夫。

sentences.en: This is a guy who, as part of his explicit mission, goes after the mainstream media.
sentences.zh: 这家伙明确以攻击主流媒体为己任。

sentences.en: How did it come to be that you actually made contact with him?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么联系上他的？

sentences.en: Can you hear me?
sentences.zh: 你能听到我说话吗？

sentences.en: No, it's like not a good connection.
sentences.zh: 不，信号不太好。

sentences.en: It's sort of like breaking up.
sentences.zh: 听起来断断续续的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I go back a number of years with James O'Keefe.
sentences.zh: 是的，我和詹姆斯·奥基夫认识好几年了。

sentences.en: He's had this career over about a decade of being sort of the leading purveyor of this form of undercover journalism, is what he would call it.
sentences.zh: 在过去十年左右的职业生涯中，他一直是这种他所谓的“卧底新闻”的主要传播者。

sentences.en: James O'Keefe drew national attention for his undercover videos of Acorn.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·奥基夫因其针对“社区组织协会”（Acorn）的卧底视频而受到全国关注。

sentences.en: It's a shocking undercover video of Acorn, made by filmmaker James O'Keefe, a 25-year-old conservative activiSt.
sentences.zh: 这是一段令人震惊的卧底视频，由电影制作人、25岁的保守派活动家詹姆斯·奥基夫拍摄，内容关于“社区组织协会”。

sentences.en: Workers at Baltimore's Acorn office are secretly videotaped, helping a woman posing as a prostitute cheat on her taxes.
sentences.zh: 巴尔的摩Acorn办公室的工作人员被秘密录像，他们帮助一名冒充妓女的女子逃税。

sentences.en: Now he's caught an NPR executive on tape describing the Tea Party as raciSt.
sentences.zh: 现在，他又录下了美国国家公共电台（NPR）的一名高管称“茶党”为种族主义者。

sentences.en: Today, James O'Keefe, Project Veritas, well, they came out with a new video that apparently shows a CNN producer admitting the network's massive anti-Trump agenda.
sentences.zh: 今天，詹姆斯·奥基夫和他的“真理计划”发布了一段新视频，显然显示一名CNN制片人承认该电视网有大规模的反特朗普议程。

sentences.en: That thrust him into the spotlight, made him sort of a darling of the conservative movement, and launched him on this career where he started his own nonprofit group,
sentences.zh: 这让他成为了焦点，使他成为保守派运动的宠儿，并开启了他的职业生涯，他创办了自己的非营利组织，

sentences.en: to raise a bunch of money for it, to carry out sort of similar stings of institutions that he sees as either corrupt or as hopelessly biased in favor of the left.
sentences.zh: 为它筹集大量资金，去对那些他认为腐败或无可救药地偏向左翼的机构进行类似的卧底行动。

sentences.en: And why do you want to talk to O'Keefe about this right now?
sentences.zh: 你为什么现在想和奥基夫谈谈这件事？

sentences.en: The Washington Post says it was targeted by an organization that was attempting to discredit its exclusive reporting into sexual misconduct.
sentences.zh: 《华盛顿邮报》称，它遭到了一个组织的针对，该组织试图抹黑其关于性骚扰的独家报道。

sentences.en: So I called James because he's back in the news, as he often is when one of his sting operations goes bad, and this one went very bad.
sentences.zh: 所以我给詹姆斯打了电话，因为他又上了新闻，就像他那些卧底行动搞砸时一样，而这次搞得非常糟糕。

sentences.en: The Washington Post was approached by a woman named Jamie Phillips who made inflammatory charges against Roy Moore,
sentences.zh: 《华盛顿邮报》被一名叫杰米·菲利普斯的女子接触，她对罗伊·摩尔提出了煽动性的指控，

sentences.en: saying the Alabama Senate candidate impregnated her when she was 15 and drove her to have an abortion.
sentences.zh: 称这位阿拉巴马州参议院候选人在她15岁时让她怀孕，并开车带她去堕胎。

sentences.en: This was an effort by James O'Keefe to sort of discredit the Washington Post reporting, but...
sentences.zh: 这是詹姆斯·奥基夫试图抹黑《华盛顿邮报》报道的一次尝试，但是……

sentences.en: The Post became suspicious about the woman's claims and recorded a conversation with her.
sentences.zh: 《华盛顿邮报》对该女子的说法产生了怀疑，并录下了与她的谈话。

sentences.en: The Post turned the tables on him, using some of his same techniques to expose him before he could do the same to them.
sentences.zh: 《华盛顿邮报》以其人之道还治其人之身，利用他的一些手段在他对自己下手之前揭露了他。

sentences.en: So has that pretty much been O'Keefe's story and his MO, taking on, quote-unquote, fake news and liberal institutions, but through very questionable tactics?
sentences.zh: 那么，奥基夫的故事和行事风格一直都是这样吗？通过非常可疑的手段去对付所谓的“假新闻”和自由派机构？

sentences.en: It seems sort of contradictory.
sentences.zh: 这看起来有点矛盾。

sentences.en: How does he talk about his tactics and his aims?
sentences.zh: 他是如何谈论自己的策略和目标的？

sentences.en: I think his approach is largely that the ends justify the means, but it is something that he's done a lot of thinking about and is happy to elaborate on,
sentences.zh: 我认为他的方法很大程度上是“目的证明手段正确”，但他对此思考了很多，也很乐意详细阐述，

sentences.en: as he has with me and others over the years, this question of the ethics, and I'm sort of using air quotes around that,
sentences.zh: 正如他多年来对我和其他人所做的那样，关于伦理的问题——我这里用了引号——

sentences.en: but the ethics of misrepresentation and when it is okay to misrepresent yourself in order to get a story.
sentences.zh: 也就是虚假陈述的伦理，以及为了获得报道而伪装身份在何时是可接受的。

sentences.en: We, in traditional journalism, we don't do that.
sentences.zh: 在传统新闻界，我们不这样做。

sentences.en: There's a bright line.
sentences.zh: 有一条明确的界限。

sentences.en: We never misrepresent ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我们从不伪装自己。

sentences.en: He believes that those are sort of stodgy tenets that prevent journalists from getting at the truth,
sentences.zh: 他认为那些是陈腐的信条，阻碍了记者探求真相，

sentences.en: and he is able to point to some of these examples of really groundbreaking journalism that was done undercover.
sentences.zh: 他能够指出一些通过卧底方式完成的开创性新闻报道作为例子。

sentences.en: That said, the degree to which he has sort of misrepresented himself and also the way he's gotten a lot of criticism
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，他伪装自己的程度，以及他因视频的选择性剪辑而受到的批评，

sentences.en: for the selective editing of his videos, those are things that I think most assessments of journalism would deem to be out of bounds.
sentences.zh: 这些都是我认为大多数新闻评估会认为越界的事情。

sentences.en: Straight to the people.
sentences.zh: 直接面向民众。

sentences.en: Bypassing and circumventing the mainstream media.
sentences.zh: 绕过并规避主流媒体。

sentences.en: With the Jamie Phillips Washington Post thing and the Roy Moore story, the effort was to get these reporters to reveal something about their goals or their motives or tactics
sentences.zh: 关于杰米·菲利普斯和《华盛顿邮报》那件事，以及罗伊·摩尔的故事，其目的是让这些记者透露关于他们的目标、动机或策略的信息，

sentences.en: that would compromise their reporting, right?
sentences.zh: 从而损害他们的报道，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's to expose the truth about them.
sentences.zh: 这是为了揭露关于他们的真相。

sentences.en: But the truth that was exposed is that they were doing their job in a very diligent fashion, right?
sentences.zh: 但揭露出来的真相是，他们一直在非常勤勉地工作，对吧？

sentences.en: So do they want a Nobel Prize for that?
sentences.zh: 所以他们想要因此获得诺贝尔奖吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: I think that's what, in talking to sources, that's part of what appeals to Donald Trump about James O'Keefe.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是在与消息人士交谈时，唐纳德·特朗普被詹姆斯·奥基夫吸引的部分原因。

sentences.en: He sees James O'Keefe as a self-made man who was willing to take these big risks.
sentences.zh: 他把詹姆斯·奥基夫看作一个白手起家、愿意承担巨大风险的人。

sentences.en: There's a little bit of parallel there between the way Donald Trump sees himself and sort of that characterization of O'Keefe.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普看待自己的方式与对奥基夫的这种描述之间，确实有一点相似之处。

sentences.en: So these two men, James O'Keefe and Donald Trump, have a relationship.
sentences.zh: 所以这两个人，詹姆斯·奥基夫和唐纳德·特朗普，是有联系的。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: We found that there was an initial meeting between the two back in 2013.
sentences.zh: 我们发现他们两人在2013年有过一次初步会面。

sentences.en: Donald Trump might be considering another run for the White House.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普可能正在考虑再次竞选总统。

sentences.en: If not, it's not clear why he's suddenly spending so much time at Republican Party events.
sentences.zh: 如果不是这样，很难解释他为什么突然花这么多时间参加共和党的活动。

sentences.en: So it was in that context that he summoned O'Keefe to Trump Tower and praised O'Keefe's work, said he was a good-looking guy, that's a quote that Trump uses for a lot of people,
sentences.zh: 所以就是在那种背景下，他把奥基夫召到了特朗普大厦，称赞了奥基夫的工作，说他是个帅小伙——这是特朗普对很多人都用过的一句话——

sentences.en: and offered to stay in touch.
sentences.zh: 并提出保持联系。

sentences.en: And in May of 2015, Donald Trump wrote a check to James O'Keefe's group, Project Veritas, from the Trump Foundation for $10,000.
sentences.zh: 2015年5月，唐纳德·特朗普通过特朗普基金会给詹姆斯·奥基夫的组织“真理计划”开了一张1万美元的支票。

sentences.en: And then...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: I am officially running for president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 我正式竞选美国总统。

sentences.en: After Donald Trump announces his campaign for president, he again brings James O'Keefe into Trump Tower.
sentences.zh: 在唐纳德·特朗普宣布竞选总统后，他再次把詹姆斯·奥基夫请到了特朗普大厦。

sentences.en: James O'Keefe previews for Donald Trump some raw video footage that he had just taken from Hillary Clinton's campaign announcement rally on Roosevelt Island in New York,
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·奥基夫向唐纳德·特朗普展示了一些原始视频片段，这些片段是他刚从希拉里·克林顿在纽约罗斯福岛举行的竞选发布集会上拍摄的，

sentences.en: not far from Trump Tower.
sentences.zh: 离特朗普大厦不远。

sentences.en: Hey, Erin, wait, before you take another person, so she's Canadian.
sentences.zh: 嘿，艾琳，等等，在你采访下一个人之前，她是加拿大人。

sentences.en: And this video purported to show members of Hillary Clinton's campaign accepting a payment for campaign swag, like buttons, from a Canadian woman.
sentences.zh: 这段视频据称显示希拉里·克林顿竞选团队的成员接受了一名加拿大女子为竞选周边产品（如徽章）支付的款项。

sentences.en: So it'll be a total of 75.
sentences.zh: 总共是75美元。

sentences.en: And that would be a violation of election laws that bar campaign contributions from foreigners.
sentences.zh: 这将违反禁止外国人进行竞选捐款的选举法。

sentences.en: So O'Keefe just has this raw video.
sentences.zh: 所以奥基夫手里就有这段原始视频。

sentences.en: He goes into Trump Tower.
sentences.zh: 他去了特朗普大厦。

sentences.en: He shows it to Trump.
sentences.zh: 他给特朗普看了。

sentences.en: Trump apparently likes it, commits to giving more money to James O'Keefe's nonprofit.
sentences.zh: 特朗普显然很喜欢，并承诺给詹姆斯·奥基夫的非营利组织更多的钱。

sentences.en: And in fact, we don't have to look too much further into the future to see Donald Trump highlighting both on social media and even in a debate subsequent James O'Keefe videos
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们不需要往后看太久就能看到唐纳德·特朗普在社交媒体上，甚至在随后的辩论中强调詹姆斯·奥基夫的视频，

sentences.en: that are attempts to embarrass Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 这些视频旨在让希拉里·克林顿难堪。

sentences.en: Donald Trump earlier today talking about the damning Project Veritas undercover tapes that allegedly show Democratic operatives scheming to cause violence at Trump rallies.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普今天早些时候谈到了那些令人震惊的“真理计划”卧底录音，据称显示民主党特工密谋在特朗普集会上制造暴力。

sentences.en: It just came out, and I give a lot of credit to the people that brought this out.
sentences.zh: 这刚出来，我非常感谢那些把这些东西曝光出来的人。

sentences.en: Believe me.
sentences.zh: 相信我。

sentences.en: Now that Trump is president, has his support emboldened Project Veritas and James O'Keefe?
sentences.zh: 现在特朗普当了总统，他的支持是否壮大了“真理计划”和詹姆斯·奥基夫？

sentences.en: Yeah, James O'Keefe certainly feels validated by Donald Trump, but Donald Trump's focus on assailing the institutions of the left and calling out fake news.
sentences.zh: 是的，詹姆斯·奥基夫当然感到受到了唐纳德·特朗普的认可，但唐纳德·特朗普专注于抨击左翼机构并指责假新闻。

sentences.en: O'Keefe pointed to a particular briefing.
sentences.zh: 奥基夫提到了一个特别的简报会。

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: Nice crowd.
sentences.zh: 人真多。

sentences.en: The White House press secretary Sarah Huckabee Sanders gave in June.
sentences.zh: 白宫新闻秘书萨拉·赫卡比·桑德斯在六月份举行了简报会。

sentences.en: There's a video circulating now, whether it's accurate or not.
sentences.zh: 现在流传着一段视频，不管它是否准确。

sentences.en: I don't know, but I would encourage everybody in this room and frankly, everybody across the country to take a look at it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，但我鼓励在座的各位，坦率地说，鼓励全国的每一个人都去看一看。

sentences.en: Where she urged viewers, she urged the press, she urged all Americans to go watch a secretly
sentences.zh: 她敦促观众，敦促媒体，敦促所有美国人去观看一段秘密

sentences.en: recorded Project Veritas video of a CNN employee appearing to question the network's coverage of the investigation into Trump and Russia.
sentences.zh: 录制的“真理计划”视频，视频中一名CNN员工似乎在质疑该电视网对特朗普与俄罗斯调查的报道。

sentences.en: She said, I think if it is accurate, I think it's a disgrace to all of media, to all of journalism.
sentences.zh: 她说，我想如果它是准确的，我认为这对所有媒体、所有新闻业来说都是一种耻辱。

sentences.en: And what O'Keefe told me was that that briefing, in many ways, it's serving Veritas' mission.
sentences.zh: 奥基夫告诉我，那次简报会在许多方面都在服务于“真理计划”的使命。

sentences.en: It's serving Veritas' vision.
sentences.zh: 它服务于“真理计划”的愿景。

sentences.en: And he said, When Sarah Huckabee Sanders says, everyone go watch those videos,
sentences.zh: 他说，当萨拉·赫卡比·桑德斯说，大家都去看那些视频时，

sentences.en: she's telling people to go watch the information.
sentences.zh: 她是在告诉人们去看看这些信息。

sentences.en: It's the opposite of what the mainstream media says.
sentences.zh: 这与主流媒体所说的恰恰相反。

sentences.en: Mainstream media says, don't watch those videos.
sentences.zh: 主流媒体说，不要看那些视频。

sentences.en: Listen to us talk about James O'Keefe.
sentences.zh: 听我们谈论詹姆斯·奥基夫就行了。

sentences.en: If the media can't be trusted to report the news, then that's a dangerous place for America.
sentences.zh: 如果媒体不能被信任去报道新闻，那么这对美国来说是一个危险的境地。

sentences.en: In a sense, what we're talking about is a feedback loop.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，我们谈论的是一个反馈循环。

sentences.en: O'Keefe and Trump are this kind of powerful match in this moment.
sentences.zh: 奥基夫和特朗普在这一刻是某种强大的组合。

sentences.en: You've got the president, who loves to go after the news media and liberals, who doesn't spend much of his time worrying about supporting his claims with evidence or reporting.
sentences.zh: 你有一位喜欢攻击新闻媒体和自由派的总统，他并不花太多时间去担心用证据或报道来支持自己的主张。

sentences.en: And then you've got O'Keefe, who shares that point of view with the president, and whose videos seem to confirm some of the president's claims in a satisfying way
sentences.zh: 然后你有了奥基夫，他与总统有着相同的观点，他的视频似乎以一种令人满意的方式证实了总统的一些主张，

sentences.en: for their mutual constituencies.
sentences.zh: 满足了他们共同的支持者。

sentences.en: Is that how this works?
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样运作的吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: That's how it works when it goes off to plan.
sentences.zh: 当一切按计划进行时，就是这样运作的。

sentences.en: And so that could be a very powerful confluence and synergy there.
sentences.zh: 所以那可能是一种非常强大的汇合和协同效应。

sentences.en: What O'Keefe does and brings to the table that the president doesn't and that really no one else on the right does is something unique about it.
sentences.zh: 奥基夫所做的事情以及他带来的东西，是总统所没有的，也是右翼中真正没有其他人能做到的，这其中有独特之处。

sentences.en: And that is that he is trying to provide fodder, actual evidence, and do what he sees as good accountability journalism on the mainstream media.
sentences.zh: 那就是他试图提供素材、实际证据，并做他所认为的针对主流媒体的良好问责新闻。

sentences.en: It's not merely opining and saying this report is biased.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是发表意见说这篇报道有偏见。

sentences.en: And that's been the approach that the right has long taken.
sentences.zh: 而这正是右翼长期以来采取的方法。

sentences.en: There are groups that have received much more funding than James O'Keefe's group, including the Media Research Center,
sentences.zh: 有些组织获得的资金比詹姆斯·奥基夫的组织多得多，包括媒体研究中心，

sentences.en: which merely highlight examples of stuff that's already out there and say that this proves liberal bias.
sentences.zh: 他们只是强调已经存在的东西的例子，并说这证明了自由派偏见。

sentences.en: James O'Keefe is taking it a step further, and he's doing it in a much more brazen way that does raise these questions about his tactics.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·奥基夫更进一步，而且他以一种更厚颜无耻的方式这样做，这确实引发了关于他策略的问题。

sentences.en: But that's also the reason why he has had a significant impact in the cases where he has landed blows.
sentences.zh: 但这也是为什么他在成功打击目标的情况下产生了重大影响的原因。

sentences.en: And it's also the reason why when things go south for him in his operations, as it did this past week with the Washington Post,
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么当他的行动对他不利时，就像上周《华盛顿邮报》那件事一样，

sentences.en: I think it backfires even more spectacularly, because now he has the endorsement of the White House.
sentences.zh: 我认为这会产生更具破坏性的反作用，因为现在他有了白宫的背书。

sentences.en: Now he is sort of seen as a soldier in this war against fake news.
sentences.zh: 现在他被视为这场反假新闻战争中的一名士兵。

sentences.en: And so when it blows up, it's sort of his critics pounce even more gleefully than they might have done so before.
sentences.zh: 所以当它搞砸时，他的批评者们比以前更加幸灾乐祸地发起攻击。

sentences.en: The media cannot abide us.
sentences.zh: 媒体无法容忍我们。

sentences.en: Media, media, and a media who cannot abide us,
sentences.zh: 媒体，媒体，一个无法容忍我们的媒体，

sentences.en: he defined as journalists.
sentences.zh: 他将其定义为记者。

sentences.en: But what does it mean to backfire or blow up?
sentences.zh: 但“反作用”或“搞砸”是什么意思？

sentences.en: I guess I'm surprised to hear you use those words, because in a country this divided, does anything ever really backfire if your intentions and your audience agree with you?
sentences.zh: 我猜听到你用这些词我很惊讶，因为在一个如此分裂的国家，如果你的意图和你的受众与你一致，事情真的会产生反作用吗？

sentences.en: I mean, that may be the lesson.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这可能就是教训。

sentences.en: Even when he fails, he sort of fails up.
sentences.zh: 即使他失败了，他也是在“向上失败”。

sentences.en: It's unclear whether his botch stings will even hurt him in this day and age.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚他拙劣的卧底行动在当今时代是否真的会伤害到他。

sentences.en: James O'Keefe has had these cycles where he's really mattered a lot, and then he's seen as irrelevant, and then he matters again.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·奥基夫经历过这样的周期：他真的非常重要，然后被视为无关紧要，接着又变得重要起来。

sentences.en: Ken, I think he could matter even more now when he is able to pull off these things successfully because he's got this ally in the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 肯，我认为他现在可能更重要，因为他能够成功地完成这些事情，因为他在椭圆形办公室有这样一个盟友。

sentences.en: Ken, thank you.
sentences.zh: 肯，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 感激不尽。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: On Saturday evening,
sentences.zh: 周六晚上，

sentences.en: President Trump called for a Washington Post reporter to be fired over a misleading tweet about the size of a crowd at a Trump rally in Florida.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统呼吁开除一名《华盛顿邮报》记者，原因是他发布了一条关于佛罗里达州特朗普集会人数的误导性推文。

sentences.en: The reporter had posted a picture of an arena with many empty seats.
sentences.zh: 该记者发布了一张体育场内有许多空座的照片。

sentences.en: On Saturday night, the president posted his own photos showing a crowded arena.
sentences.zh: 周六晚上，总统发布了他自己的照片，显示体育场内座无虚席。

sentences.en: Demand apology and retraction from fake news WAPO, he wrote.
sentences.zh: 他写道：“要求假新闻《华盛顿邮报》道歉并撤回报道。”

sentences.en: The reporter, David Weigel, later apologized and deleted the tweet.
sentences.zh: 该记者戴维·魏格尔后来道歉并删除了推文。

sentences.en: Very fair to call me out, he wrote on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 他在推特上写道：“指出我的错误是非常公正的。”

sentences.en: That followed another episode on Friday when CNN corrected an erroneous report that Donald Trump Jr.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，CNN周五还更正了一篇错误报道，称小唐纳德·特朗普

sentences.en: had received advance notice from WikiLeaks about a trove of hacked documents released during last year's presidential campaign.
sentences.zh: 曾提前收到维基解密关于去年总统竞选期间发布的一批被黑文件的通知。

sentences.en: In fact, the email to Trump was sent the day after the documents, stolen from the DNC, were made public, undercutting the thrust of CNN's report.
sentences.zh: 事实上，发给特朗普的那封邮件是在这些从民主党全国委员会窃取的文件公开后的第二天发出的，这削弱了CNN报道的核心内容。

sentences.en: In a tweet, the president wrote that, quote, fake news CNN made a vicious and purposeful mistake.
sentences.zh: 总统在推特上写道，引用他的话，“假新闻CNN犯了一个恶毒且蓄意的错误”。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: This is the new normal.
sentences.zh: 这就是新常态。

sentences.en: And this could be something that happens every year or every few years.
sentences.zh: 而且这可能成为每年或每隔几年就会发生的事情。

sentences.en: It happens to some degree.
sentences.zh: 它在一定程度上确实会发生。

sentences.en: It's just more intense, more widespread, and then we're about ready to have firefighting at Christmas.
sentences.zh: 只是现在变得更强烈、更广泛了，我们甚至快要到圣诞节还得去救火的地步了。

sentences.en: As wildfires continued to rage through Southern California over the weekend, killing one person and destroying more than 800 buildings,
sentences.zh: 随着周末野火继续在南加州肆虐，造成一人死亡，并摧毁了800多栋建筑，

sentences.en: Governor Jerry Brown told residents this should be what they expect in the decades ahead.
sentences.zh: 州长杰里·布朗告诉居民，这应该是他们未来几十年所预期的状况。

sentences.en: It is the way the world is with the kind of carbon pollution that we're not only living with, but we're generating still.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们所处的世界，我们不仅生活在碳污染中，而且还在持续制造这种污染。

sentences.en: It's still increasing.
sentences.zh: 它仍在增加。

sentences.en: We have to make that turn.
sentences.zh: 我们必须做出改变。

sentences.en: It's going to take heroic efforts.
sentences.zh: 这将需要英雄般的努力。

sentences.en: There are many places in this country that don't get it yet.
sentences.zh: 在这个国家的许多地方，人们还没有意识到这一点。

sentences.en: There are several countries in the world that don't quite get it.
sentences.zh: 世界上还有几个国家对此还不太理解。

sentences.en: So we're going to have to be good stewards of our own neighborhoods and state, but also missionaries to spread the word that we do need to make a change.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不仅要做好自己社区和州的守护者，还要成为传道者，传播我们需要做出改变的信息。

sentences.en: On Sunday,
sentences.zh: 周日，

sentences.en: California officials issued new evacuation orders, this time for several neighborhoods in Santa Barbara County.
sentences.zh: 加州官员发布了新的撤离令，这次针对的是圣巴巴拉县的几个社区。

sentences.en: There are now more than 4,000 firefighters trying to put out the blazes.
sentences.zh: 目前有超过4000名消防员正在努力扑灭大火。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台受到严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和莎拉·凯尼格主持的最新一期《地铁》节目中，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》节目。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在任何你收听播客的平台上订阅收听。
